tools.name: cleo_sentient_status
tools.description: Query the CLEO sentient subsystem status. Returns daemon state, kill-switch status, Tier-2 enabled flag, and proposal statistics.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the CLEO project root. Defaults to the adapter working directory.

tools.name: cleo_sentient_propose_list
tools.description: List Tier-2 (autonomous) proposals generated by the CLEO sentient subsystem. Returns proposals with status=proposed, sorted by weight descending.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the CLEO project root.

limit.description: Maximum number of proposals to return (default: 20).

tools.name: cleo_sentient_propose_enable
tools.description: Enable Tier-2 autonomous proposal generation. Subject to M7 gate on the CLEO side: `cleo memory doctor --assert-clean` must pass before this succeeds. Returns success or E_M7_GATE_FAILED with guidance on cleaning the brain corpus.

projectRoot.description: Absolute path to the CLEO project root.
